Nettle (libnettle, libhogweed)

Licence: LGPL-3.0-or-later or GPL-2.0-or-later.

The MSYS2 package that supplies this DLL ships no licence file, so this
directory holds the licence texts the upstream source distribution names,
copied verbatim from other packages on the build machine (the texts are
identical across projects). apps/windows/deps.py copies this directory into
the payload's ThirdParty folder.
